assets.prompt: Create ONE photorealistic architectural wall texture from the supplied Korean job interview room reference. The image fills edge to edge with this wall only: top edge is wall/ceiling junction, bottom edge is floor/skirting junction, but NO visible ceiling or floor. Exact straight horizontal and vertical lines, no perspective convergence, no corner, no depth perspective. Image left edge is the FRONT interview-panel end, image right edge is the REAR applicant end. Natural worn utilitarian textures, slight dust on sills, fine fabric paint and imperfect real blinds but restrained. No people, furniture, plants, doors, writing, signage, shadows of humans. Documentary architectural photograph, not CGI, no dramatic lighting, no game styling. Correct scale, uniform frontal elevation throughout. Maintain the quiet severe office atmosphere of the reference. Do not copy the three people or table.
